text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black ran her Debut race to the 
very end. However, she wore a rather glum 
expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hounded by the terrifying stakes of the 
real deal today, all she could do was run 
recklessly with reckless abandon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can't move the audience running the 
way she does now. Kitasan Black felt this 
truth deeply in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until next year's Classic Triple Crown, it 
was decided she would run appropriate 
races to build up her foundation.
